sentences.en: I got a premium for subscribing to the magazine.

sentences.en: Good work will be rewarded with a hefty premium.
sentences.zh: 出色的工作会得到丰厚的奖励。

sentences.en: Free time is at a premium for working parents.
sentences.zh: 工作繁忙让父母们很难有空闲时间。
